messages:
maya: FYI I opened a thread PR that consolidates the v1->v2 migration checklist and adds a short 'phased shim sunset' runbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872. Looking for reviewers on wording and redirect coverage.

raj: Re: shim section 11 do we document the exact behavior of the shim for Dedicated customers? We should be explicit about headers, return shapes, and rate-limit differences.

cleo: Yes please. Dedicated customers rely on the shim for some pinned integrations. I'd suggest a small table: "shim behavior vs native v2" with three rows (auth, streaming framing, error codes).

tess: I can draft that table. Also proposing a short CLI example showing the new `redwood generate` and a note: "If you are using the legacy `model invoke` command, install CLI v1.9 to keep behavior during the 6-week shim window."

maya: Good. Add a short code sample for the streaming change. Many folks have been tripped by the shift from `text` to `delta.text` tokens.

raj: Also add a callout: if you depend on the older `choices[0].text` shape, point them to the compatibility wrapper snippet we keep in sdk-extras.

cleo: Small style nit: please avoid using "sunset" alone in docs headers; ops asked for "phased sunset (soft removal)" language. Use consistent copy across the guide and the deprecation notice.

maya: Updated PR with that language.

infra-bot: Redirect patch staged: redirects.csv updated -> /api/v1/models -> /guides/migration/v1-to-v2 (preview active).

sam: Quick technical detail: the shim will translate `invoke` params to `generate` semantics but will only emulate non-streaming responses synchronously. We should warn users that streaming through the shim is proxied and may add 50-200ms. Add that to the perf FAQ.

cleo: Added perf note and suggested wording in the PR.

tess: Drafted the compatibility snippets. JS snippet shows both calls side-by-side and a tiny helper: 
```js
// new
const g = await client.generate({ model: 'rwd-1', input: 'Summarize: ...' });
// shim fallback (deprecated)
const old = await client.invoke({ model: 'rwd-1', input: 'Summarize: ...' });
```
Also included a short note about pinning older SDK versions.

raj: Please ensure Python parity. The Python client uses `client.generate()` as well but method names and named arguments differ. Add a short mapping table.

maya: I added a mapping table to the PR: JS -> Py -> CLI. Included `method` -> `api_call` rename note for SDKs pinned <2.0.

infra-bot: Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-4872--docs.redwood.dev/ (expires in 24h), smoke tests queued.

cleo: Found a small rendering problem: the mapping table was too wide and breaks mobile layout. I changed to a vertical list per SDK which renders cleanly.

sam: Smoke tests green except one snippet lint warning: missing trailing newline in py snippet. Fix pushed.

tess: Also added an ops-runbook item: if major regressions are reported during the six-week shim, we will extend shim for documented enterprise customers by request; include contact channel `#eng-ops` and the enterprise support Pager.

maya: Added the enterprise exception wording and linked the Dedicated contract clause.

raj: One last ask: can we include a short migration checklist in the top of the guide (3 steps: opt-in to preview, update SDK callsites, run smoke tests)? The goal is minimal scannability.

cleo: Done. I trimmed it to 3 bullets and added links to examples.

maya: Final pass: updated changelog entry and added deprecation banner copy. Will hold merge until Tuesday 2pm to allow any last-minute Dedicated customer feedback.

sam: I'm marking items complete on the PR checklist and will merge after the freeze window if no blockers.

maya: Thanks team. If anyone spots a content regression in preview, drop a reply here and reference the file path in the PR. :thumbsup:
